plan: Queue carry as primary. It is Cuban's best role at 58.0% over 175 games (overall is 50.6%). Set offlane as secondary, not the other way around.
Stop queueing midlane: 42.9% over 168 games is costing real VP. When auto-filled there, play the safest comfort pick, not a learning pick.
Comfort-hero rule for the climb: Sparrow. Compared with the average player on the same hero, Cuban wins about 11.3 more games per 100 on it.
Cuban's champion pool is 12+ heroes wide and the top three are only 31% of the games. Gold-to-Platinum climbs are almost always pool-narrowing stories: aim for 70%+ of games on the top three.
Park Countess, Lt. Belica for ranked: 32% over 65; 39% over 64. Keep them for normals.
The math: Cuban is at 566 VP; Platinum III starts at 900. The all-time peak is 824.
honesty: personal winrates are shrunk toward the player's own average (small heater samples do not count as mains)
field baselines are all-ranks aggregates from our current-patch match sample, not Gold-bracket-specific yet
winrate edges are observational; they say where the player wins, not why

insights.title: Cuban is a closer, not a marathoner
insights.finding: Games under 28 minutes: 70%. Past 32: 29%. Press early leads and call objectives; do not let games drift.
insights.receipt: wins 14 of 20 short games vs 4 of 14 long ones, recent sample

insights.title: Goldilocks324 brings out Cuban's best
insights.finding: Cuban's record alongside Goldilocks324 is 56% over 268 ranked games — the strongest pairing in the stack. When only two of the squad queue, make it this pair.

insights.title: For the group chat
insights.finding: 2 pentakills in ranked and a longest spree of 16 (plus 27 more in casual modes — the group chat can rule on whether those count). Cuban has receipts.

insights.title: Cuban punches back after losses
insights.finding: Cuban wins MORE right after a loss (70%) than after a win (42%). Tilt is not the problem; complacency might be.
insights.receipt: 16/23 after losses vs 11/26 after wins, last 50 games
